outputs.L1: This receiving apparatus includes: a broadcast reception unit configured to receive a broadcast signal including a broadcast program and tag information, the broadcast program including at least one scene, and the tag information including information that is transmitted in temporal correspondence with each of the at least one scene of the broadcast program and is necessary for acquiring related information associated with the broadcast program; an application controller configured to acquire an application that uses the related information and an application information table in which at least identification information for identifying the tag information, information for controlling an operation of the application, and information for identifying the related information used by the application are described, and to control the operation of the application based on the application information table; and a tag information processing unit configured to acquire, from the received broadcast signal, the tag information based on the identification information described in the application information table, to acquire the related information based on the tag information, and to supply the related information to the application being executed.
outputs.L2:
The receiving device comprises a broadcast receiver that is arranged to obtain a broadcast signal containing both a broadcast program and tag data. The broadcast program has one or more scenes, and the tag data contains information sent in time alignment with each of the one or more scenes of the program, the information being required to obtain related information associated with the broadcast program.  

The device also includes an application controller that obtains an application using the related information, along with an application information table. This table describes at least identification data for recognizing the tag information, information for managing how the application operates, and information for specifying the related information used by the application. The application controller controls execution of the application according to the application information table.  

In addition, the device includes a tag information processor that, using the identification information stated in the application information table, extracts the tag information from the received broadcast signal, obtains the related information on the basis of that tag information, and provides the related information to the application currently running.
outputs.L3:
A receiving apparatus is configured to receive a broadcasting signal that includes both a broadcast program and tag information associated with specific scenes or portions of the program. The tag information is transmitted in correspondence with the broadcast content and is used to identify or retrieve additional information related to the program being viewed.

The tag information includes data necessary for acquiring related information associated with the broadcast program. For example, the tag information may include identifiers, references, or access information that enables the receiving apparatus to obtain supplementary content, service data, interactive information, or other materials connected to a particular scene in the program.

The receiving apparatus also includes an application controller. The application controller acquires an application to be executed in association with the broadcast program, as well as an application information table. The application information table describes information such as tag identification information, application control information, and identifiers for related information. The tag identification information is used to identify tag information included in the broadcast signal. The application control information is used to control the behavior or execution state of the application. The related information identifiers are used to specify or acquire related information corresponding to the tag information.

Based on the application information table, the application controller controls the operation of the application. For instance, the application controller may start, stop, pause, resume, or otherwise manage the application in accordance with the control information described in the application information table. In this way, the application can operate in synchronization with the broadcast program and respond appropriately to tag information associated with particular scenes.

The receiving apparatus further includes a tag information processing unit. The tag information processing unit acquires tag information from the received broadcast signal and uses the acquired tag information to obtain related information associated with the broadcast program. The related information may be retrieved from the broadcast signal itself, from a network resource, or from another available information source, depending on the information contained in the tag. The tag information processing unit then supplies the obtained related information to the application that is currently running under the control of the application controller.

Through this configuration, the receiving apparatus enables an application to operate in coordination with a broadcast program and to present or use related information corresponding to scenes in the program. This allows the viewer to receive enhanced services, interactive features, or additional content that is dynamically linked to the broadcast program.
outputs.L4:
A receiving apparatus is configured to coordinate broadcast programs with tag information that is associated with particular scenes or portions of the broadcast content. The apparatus receives a broadcast signal that includes audio and video content, and also obtains application-related information that indicates how an application should operate in relation to the broadcast program. An application controller manages the execution of the application, while an application information table provides control information such as the location of the application, timing information, and references to data or services that may be used during the broadcast.

In operation, when a viewer watches a broadcast program, the receiving apparatus identifies scene-specific tag information corresponding to the current portion of the program. This tag information may indicate, for example, a product appearing in a scene, a performer, a location, a music track, a sports statistic, a news topic, or any other item of interest related to the televised content. A tag processing unit analyzes the tag information and determines what related content should be obtained. The related content may be retrieved from the broadcast stream itself, from a data carousel, from a network server, or from another external source.

The application controller then supplies the retrieved information to an application running on the receiving apparatus. Because the tag information is synchronized with the broadcast scene, the application can present supplemental or interactive content at an appropriate time. For example, during a drama program, the application may display details about clothing or objects shown in a particular scene. During a sports broadcast, it may provide player statistics or replay options corresponding to a specific play. During a music program, it may present artist information, lyrics, or links to purchase or stream a song.

The application information table helps ensure that the application is properly launched, controlled, updated, or terminated in accordance with the broadcast content. It may include information identifying the application, specifying when the application should become active, describing how the application should respond to particular tags, and indicating where additional data can be found. By referring to this table, the receiving apparatus can accurately coordinate the operation of the application with the progression of the broadcast program.

Through this arrangement, applications can obtain and use information that is closely synchronized with individual scenes of televised content. This improves the ability of broadcasters and service providers to offer interactive services, targeted supplemental information, enhanced advertising, electronic commerce features, audience participation functions, and other value-added services. As a result, the viewer can receive richer and more relevant information without interrupting the broadcast experience, while the receiving apparatus efficiently manages the relationship between the broadcast program, the application, and the scene-specific tag information.

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe, in formal patent language, the components and functions of a television receiving apparatus that processes temporally corresponding tag information in a broadcast stream to provide related information to an executed application.
counterfactuals.output:
A television receiving apparatus is provided for receiving a broadcast stream including audiovisual content and tag information temporally associated with the audiovisual content, and for supplying information related to the tag information to an application executed by the apparatus.

The television receiving apparatus may comprise a broadcast receiving unit configured to receive a broadcast signal carrying a transport stream. The transport stream includes video data, audio data, and metadata, the metadata including tag information associated with a predetermined temporal position or temporal interval of the video and/or audio data. The broadcast receiving unit may include a tuner, a demodulator, and an error-correction circuit configured to acquire and output the transport stream.

The apparatus may further comprise a stream processing unit configured to demultiplex the transport stream into constituent data streams. The stream processing unit separates the video data, the audio data, and the tag information, and supplies the video data and audio data to respective decoding units. A video decoder and an audio decoder decode the separated video data and audio data to generate a display signal and an audio output signal, respectively.

A tag information acquiring unit is configured to acquire, from the broadcast stream, tag information corresponding to a presentation time of the audiovisual content. The tag information may include, for example, identification information, content identification data, scene identification data, product information, program-related information, uniform resource locator information, application control information, or other metadata associated with a scene, frame, segment, or reproduction time of the broadcast content.

A time management unit is configured to manage temporal correspondence between the reproduced audiovisual content and the tag information. The time management unit may use a presentation time stamp, program clock reference, system time clock, segment time information, or other timing information included in the broadcast stream to determine whether particular tag information corresponds to a currently reproduced portion of the audiovisual content.

An application execution unit is configured to execute an application stored in a memory or obtained through a communication network. The application may be executed concurrently with display of the broadcast content and may request information associated with the currently displayed broadcast content.

A control unit is configured to determine, based on the timing information, tag information that temporally corresponds to the audiovisual content being presented when the application is executed or when a request is issued by the application. The control unit provides the determined tag information, or related information derived therefrom, to the application execution unit.

In one embodiment, the apparatus further comprises a related-information acquiring unit configured to acquire related information corresponding to the tag information. The related-information acquiring unit may access a local storage device or a server through a network communication unit using an identifier, address, or query included in the tag information. The related information may include text, images, audio, video, electronic commerce information, advertising information, supplemental program information, interactive content, or control data for the application.

The application execution unit receives the related information from the control unit or the related-information acquiring unit and performs processing based thereon. Such processing may include displaying supplemental information over or adjacent to the broadcast video, updating a user interface, presenting an interactive service, storing associated data, transmitting a response to a server, or controlling operation of the application in synchronization with the broadcast content.

A storage unit may be provided for temporarily storing the tag information together with corresponding temporal information. The storage unit enables the apparatus to retrieve tag information associated with a current, past, or near-future reproduction time of the broadcast content. The control unit may select tag information from the storage unit according to a temporal relationship between the tag information and the execution timing of the application.

Accordingly, the television receiving apparatus is capable of extracting tag information from a broadcast stream, determining tag information that temporally corresponds to reproduced audiovisual content, acquiring or generating related information based on the tag information, and supplying the related information to an application executed by the apparatus, thereby enabling the application to operate in association with the content currently being viewed.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Create an abstract-style apparatus description for a broadcast receiver capable of receiving scene-linked tag information, acquiring an application and metadata table, extracting relevant tag information, retrieving related content, and supplying it to the application.
counterfactuals.output: An apparatus is provided for processing broadcast content associated with scene-linked tag information. The apparatus includes a broadcast receiving unit configured to receive a broadcast signal including audiovisual content and tag information linked to scenes of the audiovisual content. A control unit is configured to acquire, from the received broadcast signal or from an external server, an application associated with the broadcast content and a metadata table describing tag information usable by the application. The control unit extracts, from the received tag information, relevant tag information corresponding to the acquired metadata table and determines content related to the relevant tag information. A communication unit is configured to retrieve the related content from a network source. The control unit supplies the retrieved related content, or information derived therefrom, to the application, thereby enabling the application to provide an interactive service synchronized with or otherwise associated with a scene of the broadcast content.
